Business:
CIB Technology
Job ID
：
62957
Principal Responsibilities
Set the strategy and technical direction for the AI gateway and broader knowledge in Agentic AI, defining agent architecture, standards, and guardrails that scale consistently bank-wide.
Lead optimization of the AI Agent to improve performance, scalability, resilience and cost efficiency, enabling Generative and Agentic AI use cases across GPS.
Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI and ML technologies for CEAIA, with a focus on LLM, agentic AI, RAG, knowledge management, and emerging engineering patterns.
Embed AI-native capabilities into engineering workflows, such as AI coding, technical solution generation, test case generation, test report generation, and automated environment setup/orchestration.
Lead architecture design and core capability development for AI Agent Applications, including task orchestration, tool invocation, context management, memory mechanisms, and multi-agent collaboration.
Own end-to-end delivery from design through rollout and continuous improvement, ensuring low-latency performance and reliability for agent-driven applications.
Runtime governance & operational framework, Establish AI agent runtime and governance frameworks, including Isolation and sandboxing, Access control and permission, Auditability and traceability Evaluation and quality measurement.
Knowledge augmentation layer design: integrate, and apply enterprise knowledge enhancement capabilities, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), GraphRAG, Knowledge graphs (design, integration, and application)
Partner across business lines and infrastructure team to align priorities, integrate requirements and unblock delivery across regions and time zones
Provide strong technical leadership through hands-on architecture/design reviews, incident learnings and mentoring to raise engineering standards.
Build and lead a high-performing global team, ensuring capabilities and delivered fit-for-purpose with consistent quality.
Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
8+ of experience delivering enterprise software/platform solutions including 3+ years in senior engineering leadership roles, especially 2+ years in Agentic AI development.
System thinking: Strong ability to design and evolve complex systems with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance.
Proficient in Python with strong coding fundamentals and architectural judgment; hands-on experience delivering complex systems. The candidate must have strong coding skills in Numpy, Panas, NLU, NLP and machine learning algorithms.
Deep understanding of LLMs and agent architectures, including:
Task decomposition & planning
Tool use / function calling patterns
Context and session management
Memory design
Execution loops and exception handling
Practical experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph (or equivalent orchestration frameworks).
Familiarity with mainstream AI coding and developer tools (examples: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or equvlenece).
Hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise RAG, GraphRAG, or knowledge graph solutions for real application scenarios.
Proven track record designing, building, and operating large-scale, low-latency, highly available, resilient platforms and shared services (API gateway/service gateway experience strongly preferred)
Experience building secure-by-design platforms in regulated environments, with strong understanding of non-functional requirements (security, resilience, data protection, auditability)
Strong knowledge of AI capabilities and their applications in financial services, including working knowledge of Generative AI/LLM platform patterns (model access, prompt/tooling services, guardrails, evaluation/monitoring) and how to enabler safe consumption at scale.
Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing global teams spanning AI SMEs and full stack engineers across multiple regions and time zones.
Strong stakeholder management skills, able to align business lines, infrastructure and control functions; clearly articulate AI capabilities and influence senior technology and business leaders.
Experience working in Agile delivery models with strong collaboration and execution discipline.

Principal Responsibilities
In this role, you will be:
Build and enhance mobile features using Kotlin/Java (Android) and/or Swift (iOS) to support core customer journeys and growth scenarios.
Work with Product Owners, Designers, and Architects to translate business requirements into clear, actionable technical solutions and engineering designs.
Contribute to mobile architecture: modularisation, dependency management, design patterns, navigation, and state management to ensure scalability and maintainability.
Build and maintain automated testing (unit tests, UI tests, etc.).
Support and optimise CI/CD and release processes to improve repeatability and stability of delivery.
Participate in production readiness and operations collaboration: monitoring and alert optimisation, troubleshooting, defect fixes, performance tuning, and post-incident reviews/continuous improvement.
Write and maintain engineering documentation (technical designs, runbooks, operating procedures) to remain audit-friendly and traceable.
Collaborate with global teams across multiple regions to drive engineering standards and share best practices (e.g. Show & Tell / technical sharing sessions).
Requirements
To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or above (Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline).
Strong native mobile development experience:
Android: Kotlin/Java, Android SDK, Jetpack (e.g. ViewModel/Room/Navigation/Compose where applicable), threading and concurrency, performance and memory management.
iOS: Swift, UIKit/SwiftUI where applicable, concurrency, networking, persistence, performance and memory management.
Familiar with mobile engineering and build systems: Android Gradle ecosystem / iOS Xcode build, dependency management (SPM/CocoaPods, etc.).
Strong mobile architecture and engineering practices: layered design, code reviews, refactoring, technical debt management, and testability-by-design.
Familiar with automated testing and high-quality delivery: unit testing is essential; UI automation experience is a plus.
Strong API integration skills: REST/JSON, error handling, retry/fallback resilience patterns, and basic observability awareness (logs, metrics, traces).

jobs.title: Investment Manager, HSBC Qianhai (GCB 5)
jobs.descriptionText:
Ready to shape cross-border investment strategy in China?
Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
The Opportunity
This role sits at the intersection of global capital markets and China's onshore economy, offering a unique platform to design and manage sophisticated multi-asset portfolios. You will leverage HSBC's global reach alongside deep local expertise to identify investment opportunities across equities, fixed income, and alternatives. Success in this position means delivering tailored investment solutions that meet complex client mandates while navigating the evolving regulatory landscape. You will play a pivotal part in connecting international market trends with domestic opportunities, directly impacting how clients access and grow their wealth in China. The role demands a strategic approach to portfolio construction and dynamic rebalancing in response to shifting macroeconomic indicators. Your work will support the broader goal of establishing HSBC Qianhai as a unique partner in China's capital markets.
What You'll Be Doing
Evaluate diverse asset classes including global equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, and alternatives to inform investment decisions.
Conduct global macro research to identify cross-border market trends and emerging investment opportunities.
Construct and manage diversified, multi-asset portfolios tailored to client mandates.
Rebalance portfolios dynamically based on shifting macroeconomic indicators and evolving risk-return profiles.
Partner with the sales team to conduct roadshows and pitch investment strategies to internal and external clients.
Ensure strict adherence to international regulatory requirements and internal compliance guidelines across all activities.
Interpret complex market data to provide actionable insights that drive portfolio performance and client value.
Collaborate with stakeholders to align investment strategies with broader business objectives and client needs.
What We're Looking For
Minimum 3 years of professional overseas experience in investment management, portfolio management, or asset allocation. (Mandatory stipulation for QDII regulation) .
Demonstrate a deep understanding of the asset management business with direct experience in regulatory requirements for cross-border investment in China.
Apply solid research and investment experience across major asset classes to drive strategic decision-making.
Hold a CFA designation or bring equivalent demonstrable experience and expertise in the field.
Navigate complex regulatory environments and market practices specific to cross-border investment structures.
Synthesise global macroeconomic indicators into clear, actionable investment theses and portfolio adjustments.
Communicate complex investment strategies effectively to diverse audiences including clients and internal stakeholders.
Maintain the highest standards of compliance and risk management in all portfolio activities and client interactions.
Shaping China's onshore capital markets
This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of investment management within one of the world's fastest-growing economies. You will work within a diverse and inclusive environment that values merit and supports professional development at every stage. Your expertise will help clients navigate the complexities of cross-border investing while contributing to HSBC's long-term sustainable growth. We invite you to bring your skills and experience to a team committed to excellence and innovation. Join us to make a tangible impact on how global capital flows into China's markets.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering (Productivity Suite).
Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)
Job ID
：58138
Location: Guangzhou
Why join us?
HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.
You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who wants to progress through engineering depth, delivery and influence.
The Opportunity
Our team consists of around 50 engineers across the UK, India, Poland and China. We’re continuing to grow our engineering capability in China and are looking for a senior engineer to provide technical leadership across one or more engineering pods.
As a Senior Associate Director, you’ll operate as a senior individual contributor on complex, high-impact engineering problems central to HSBC Productivity Suite. This is not a people-management role. It’s for an engineer who is strongest in hands-on system design and coding and wants to progress towards Principal Engineer through technical leadership rather than formal line management.
You’ll spend more than half your time designing, writing, testing and shipping production software. You’ll own significant AI capabilities and integrations, help define our technical vision and roadmap, and raise engineering standards across our global team.
Principal Responsibilities
Spend more than half your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing, testing and shipping production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
Design and build production-grade generative AI capabilities and integrations, taking ownership from initial design through deployment, operation and continuous improvement.
Provide technical leadership across engineering pods, forming a clear technical vision, setting direction and breaking complex programmes of work into manageable deliveries.
Make sound technical decisions across performance, security, cost, maintainability, technical debt, failure handling, observability, rollout safety and long-term operability.
Shape technical strategy and roadmaps, influencing priorities and translating user needs and ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes and practical engineering plans.
Drive reusable capabilities, frameworks, engineering standards and effective technology controls, including monitoring and the safe use of AI coding tools and agents across the software development lifecycle.
Raise engineering capability through pairing, design and code reviews, practical mentoring, knowledge-sharing and example-setting, without formal line-management responsibility.
Lead continuous improvement in production stability, setting measurable goals to reduce incidents and recovery times and leading from the front during production issues.
Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications
Deep, hands-on software engineering experience, with a strong record of designing, coding and operating user-facing products and distributed services at scale.
Advanced use of AI coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to prototype, write, test and review code safely, alongside experience building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including application programming interfaces, microservices, databases, containers, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
Hands-on experience taking artificial intelligence, machine learning and generative AI solutions from experimentation through to secure, reliable production use.
Strong practical knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
Strong engineering judgement, with the ability to balance performance, security, cost, resilience, maintainability, technical debt and delivery pace when making complex design decisions.
Experience forming a technical vision, influencing business and engineering priorities, breaking complex work into manageable deliveries and raising standards through technical expertise rather than formal authority.
Strong ownership, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work autonomously across global and multicultural teams, explain technical trade-offs clearly and turn ambiguous problems into robust, measurable outcomes.
/51/LP/WX

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline
At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
(Grade: GCB4 )
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
We are seeking a visionary
Senior Digital Product Manager
to lead the strategic evolution of our Wealth Management solutions within the HSBC Mobile App. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and tangible digital execution. You will own the product roadmap, drive the delivery of transformative initiatives, and cultivate a high-performing, agile team culture that places our customers and risk management at the heart of everything we do. This is an on-site role based in our Shanghai office, fostering close collaboration and rapid innovation.
Strategic Vision & Roadmap Development
Define the Future: Leverage strategic foresight to design and own a comprehensive product roadmap that significantly enhances the competitiveness of HSBC’s Wealth Management capabilities on our Mobile App.
Customer-Centric Growth: Identify market trends and customer pain points to deliver solutions that drive measurable business growth and elevate the client experience.
Strategic Alignment: Ensure all product initiatives align with HSBC’s global wealth management objectives, digital transformation goals, and the strategic direction of the Digital Platform.
Execution, Delivery & Continuous Improvement
From Vision to Reality: Translate the strategic roadmap into a clear, actionable list of initiatives with well-defined OKRs (Objectives and Key Results).
Agile Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, risk, operations) to deliver high-quality features efficiently. Ensure all delivery adheres to HSBC’s rigorous risk and compliance frameworks.
Iterative Excellence: Champion a culture of continuous improvement. Utilize data-driven insights and regular retrospectives to refine product direction, optimize user journeys, and accelerate time-to-market.
Team Leadership & Talent Development
Inspire and Empower: Act as a catalyst for team growth, fostering an environment of psychological safety, innovation, and accountability.
Talent Cultivation: Identify potential within the team, provide mentorship, and create development plans to nurture the next generation of digital product leaders.
Collaborative Culture: Promote "We Succeed Together" by breaking down silos and encouraging diverse perspectives to solve complex product challenges.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Experience: 7+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record in Wealth Management, Fintech, or Digital Banking.
Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to build and execute long-term roadmaps that deliver significant business impact.
Delivery Excellence: Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, OKR frameworks, and the ability to manage complex delivery cycles in a fast-paced environment.
Risk Awareness & Governance: Proactive Risk Management: Possess a robust understanding of operational, conduct, and reputational risks inherent in digital wealth products. You must be able to identify potential risks early in the product lifecycle and embed mitigation strategies into the design. Regulatory & Compliance Alignment: While distinct from pure compliance, you must demonstrate a keen awareness of the regulatory landscape (e.g., suitability, appropriateness, data privacy) and ensure all product features are designed to meet these standards without compromising user experience. Risk Culture: Champion a "Risk-Aware" culture within the product team, ensuring that risk considerations are a standard part of every sprint planning, review, and retrospective. You will work closely with the Risk and Compliance functions to ensure seamless governance.
Leadership: Demonstrated experience in leading, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product teams.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or a related field; MBA or relevant certification is a plus.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Product Development
.
Business:
Chief AI Office
Job ID
：
63096
Principal Responsibilities
Reporting & stakeholders: The role reports to the Pod Lead (PO) or Product Manager (as defined by the pod operating model). The UI/UX Designer works day-to-day with Business Analysts, engineers (AI/ML Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and front-end/full-stack engineers), the QA/Testing Lead and the Tech Delivery Lead to ensure designs are buildable, testable and delivered to schedule. They partner closely with Change & Adoption Lead to support adoption through intuitive journeys and, where needed, in-product guidance. The role also collaborates with the AI Solution Architect, data/platform teams and the Responsible AI Practitioner to ensure AI-enabled experiences are transparent, safe and aligned to Group AI standards. Where required, they engage in Risk, Compliance, Legal, Privacy and Information Security to ensure that experience design supports approvals, required disclosures and evidence expectations in a regulated environment.
Scope & authority: The UI/UX Designer owns the end-to-end experience design for the pod’s AI-enabled features, from journey mapping and interaction design through to UI pattern definition, prototyping and usability validation. They are accountable for producing clear, build-ready design outputs - clickable prototypes, annotated user flows, content guidance and detailed design specifications (components, states, accessibility notes and error handling) - so delivery teams can implement with pace and minimal rework. They have the authority to propose and recommend experience options and trade-offs, grounded in user evidence and delivery constraints, including decisions around automation vs human oversight, transparency vs friction and handling of AI uncertainty and failure modes. Final decisions on product scope, investment and priority remain with the Pod Lead, but the UI/UX Designer is accountable for ensuring experience risks are surfaced early, addressed through design, and aligned to design system standards, Responsible AI expectations and required governance/approvals. The role does not own product prioritisation or backlog decisions; it influences these through tested prototypes, user evidence and clear experience trade-offs
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
This role exists to ensure AI-enabled solutions are designed around real user needs, are easy to use, and build trust - reducing rework and driving adoption. The UI/UX Designer brings clarity to complex AI behaviours through strong interaction design, validated journeys and production-ready specs.
Target journey & product definition - Partner with Pod Lead/PO, BA and business stakeholders to define the target user journeys and key moments that AI will improve. Translate AI capabilities/constraints (confidence, latency, failure modes, monitoring) into clear experience patterns and user expectations. Ensure the experience supports end-to-end outcomes, not isolated screens (e.g., request → decision/support → follow-up → audit trail).
UX discovery, research & testing standards - Plan and run lightweight discovery: stakeholder interviews, contextual enquiry, workflow walkthroughs and heuristic reviews. Define hypotheses and success measures for experience quality (task success, time-on-task, error rate, comprehension of AI outputs). Run rapid, repeatable usability testing on prototypes and early builds to validate journeys and UI patterns, synthesise findings, and drive iterative design improvements.
UI patterns, prototyping & design specification - Create wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for key flows, edge cases and system states (loading, low confidence, refusal, escalation). Provide build-ready design specifications covering components, states, empty/error cases, accessibility notes, responsive behaviour and content guidance to support build and QA. Promote reuse by applying approved design systems and reusable components/patterns; propose new components only when justified and document rationale for reuse.
Design alignment to Responsible AI and control expectations - Embed “trust cues” and transparency: what the AI did, why, confidence/limits, and what users should do next. Design for safe use: appropriate human oversight, escalation paths, confirmation steps, and prevention of harmful/incorrect actions. Partner with Responsible AI Practitioner and control functions to ensure design supports required evidence and approvals (e.g., disclosures, decision records, audit trail touchpoints).
Delivery collaboration & quality in execution - Work closely with engineers and QA to ensure designs are implemented as intended; join backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies as needed. Support design QA: verify UI implementation, interaction fidelity, accessibility compliance and content accuracy. Keep design artefacts current (journey maps, prototypes, specs) so decisions remain traceable and delivery stays unblocked.
Adoption and change support (experience-led) - Partner with Change & Adoption Lead to ensure the solution is intuitive, learnable and supported by in-product guidance where needed. Identify friction points likely to reduce adoption and recommend design changes, onboarding or comms mitigations.
/WX

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

jobs.title: Head of SSv Reliability Engineering
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Head of SSv Reliability Engineering
Business:CIB Technology
Job ID：57523
About HSBC Securities Services Technology
Securities Services (SSv) is a profitable, scalable, capital-light business at the heart of HSBC’s transaction banking, institutional client and wealth ambitions, enabling clients to safely hold, move and administer investments across global markets. It supports critical post-trade and servicing capabilities across custody and safekeeping, settlement support, corporate actions, and high-quality data and reporting, helping clients operate efficiently and meet regulatory obligations. SSv also provides services across Fund Administration, Middle Office and Transfer Agency, as well as supporting evolving client needs in Private Assets. It plays a critical role for HSBC by reinforcing institutional connectivity, supporting sustainable fee income, and capitalising on the Group’s global reach and operational strength.
SSv Technology is a 1,200-person global engineering organisation partnering with SSv business and engineering colleagues across HSBC to deliver resilient, secure and industry-leading technology services that underpin these client outcomes.
About The JobJob Description
Assume a founding leadership role in shaping the reliability strategy for HSBC SSv Technology, driving lasting improvements to the resilience of business‑critical platforms across a global organisation spanning London, India, Hong Kong and Guangzhou.
As Head of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), you will stand up a new SRE pillar within SSv Technology from the ground up. This is a build mandate, not a maintain mandate: you will design the operating model, set the roadmap, establish the culture, and build the team — while remaining close enough to the work to lead major incidents and set the technical bar yourself.
This is the first SRE leadership role of its kind in SSv Technology. Success depends on a strong Reliability Engineering mindset: designing for failure, prioritising automation, and building self-healing systems. You will think proactively about reliability risks and reliability-by-design, not just react to incidents.
You will report into the CIO of SSv Technology and act as the primary architect and evangelist for reliability engineering across custody, fund services, and post-trade platforms.
Job Responsibilities
Organisational Design, Implementation Strategy & Governance
Lead a global Reliability Engineering initiative for a 1,200-person engineering organisation, setting the strategy, outcomes and adoption plan to raise reliability maturity across teams and regions.
Design and stand up the SRE operating model for SSv Technology — evaluate central, embedded and hybrid structures, and implement the model best suited to custody, fund accounting, transfer agency and post-trade platforms across regions.
Establish the SRE function’s charter, mandate and governance, and secure alignment from SSv Technology and CIB Technology leadership.
Set the multi-year roadmap and priorities for SRE maturity — observability, incident management, automation, resiliency engineering, and toil reduction — with clear measures of progress (e.g., SLO adoption, incident trends, toil reduction, and reliability improvements).
Partner with regional technology leads, principal engineers and application engineering leads to align global practice while adapting to local regulatory and operational realities in China and across the globe.
Reliability Engineering Team Building Strategy
Hire and lead a small central SRE team of 6–7 people to provide enablement, patterns, tooling direction, coaching and incident leadership across SSv Technology.
Build an extended SRE community by identifying reliability-focused engineers across the wider engineering population and mobilising them as an embedded/virtual team within application squads.
Define how SRE engages with teams (e.g., reliability clinics, embedded rotations, design reviews, readiness assessments) to get the practice off the ground quickly and sustainably.
Implement an operating model where reliability practices are progressively internalised by application teams, reducing dependency on the central team over time.
Culture, Education & Enablement at Scale
Establish SRE culture and practice from zero: error budgets, blameless postmortems, toil reduction, reliability-as-code, and a shared operational language across application teams.
Create an education and enablement programme to upskill ~1,200 engineers on Reliability Engineering concepts and processes (e.g., SLI/SLO thinking, error budgets, incident learning, automation/toil reduction), supported by playbooks, training materials, communities of practice and targeted coaching.
Embed Reliability Engineering into day-to-day delivery by introducing pragmatic design reviews and reliability guardrails for critical changes, ensuring teams build resilient services without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Define career paths, skills frameworks and training for SRE talent, and act as the internal sponsor for the discipline.
Hire, grow and mentor a reliability engineering team based in China; build a durable talent pipeline in a competitive local market.
Hands-On Reliability Engineering
Personally lead major incident responses, root-cause analysis and remediation for SSv Technology platforms, coordinating across teams and regions to restore service rapidly and drive lasting fixes.
Drive self-healing-by-design: automated detection, safe auto-remediation patterns, resilience patterns and engineering guardrails that prevent repeat incidents and reduce manual intervention (toil).
Own stability, availability and end-to-end operational performance of business-critical SSv Technology platforms, with clear accountability for outcomes.
Drive adoption of observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana), automation and scripting (Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform), and modern distributed platforms (containers, microservices, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
Champion enterprise-authorised AI capabilities to accelerate SRE workflows — incident triage, investigation support and knowledge capture — with rigorous validation habits and data-sensitivity awareness.
Establish capacity and performance engineering practices (capacity planning, load testing, latency/throughput SLIs, saturation monitoring) for critical services.
Own and mature resilience validation (DR/BCP planning and regular failover testing; resilience game days where appropriate).
Stakeholder Partnership
Serve as a trusted advisor to SSv business and technology stakeholders, providing concise, business-focused communication during incidents and strategic initiatives.
Partner closely with Production Services, Application Development, Infrastructure, Non-Functional Risk, and Compliance/Regulatory functions to improve platform stability and operational maturity.
Represent the SRE function in governance forums, service reviews, and China-specific regulatory or technology-risk discussions.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
Formal training or certification in SRE concepts, extensive applied experience, including prior experience building or scaling a reliability engineering/SRE function from the ground up, ideally in a regulated financial-services environment.
Demonstrated Reliability Engineering mindset with evidence of designing self-healing systems and driving automation-first reliability improvements proactively (not only via process).
Proven experience leading new initiatives from scratch at scale (strategy, operating model, mobilisation, adoption and delivery across large engineering populations).
Demonstrated experience designing organisational models (central vs embedded vs hybrid) for reliability, platform, or infrastructure engineering functions.
Proven track record hiring, growing and retaining technical teams, ideally within the China/APAC technology talent market.
Strong systems thinking and problem-solving capability to assess complex, cross-domain, cross-regional production issues and drive end-to-end resolution.
Demonstrated major incident leadership, coordinating effectively across global teams to restore service rapidly and drive root-cause remediation.
Hands-on technology experience across cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), automation and scripting (Python, Shell, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform), and modern distributed platforms (containers, microservices, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
Strong observability and service management expertise (Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana; ITIL Incident/Problem/Change/Availability), with excellent verbal and written communication in English
Working knowledge of custody, fund services, and/or post-trade workflows, or strong transferable capital markets technology experience.
ITIL v4 certification (or equivalent service management experience) preferred.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
Experience integrating support models and standardising operating practice across multiple regions or legal entities.
Background in organisational or cultural change leadership, particularly introducing a new engineering discipline into an established technology organisation.
Knowledge of Securities Services domains: custody, fund accounting, transfer agency, middle office, or post-trade processing would be an advantage.
Experience partnering with Front Office or client-facing teams to support business-critical, high-availability platforms.
/LP

  • Embed Reliability Engineering into day-to-day delivery by introducing pragmatic design reviews and reliability guardrails for critical changes, ensuring teams build resilient services without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Define career paths, skills frameworks and training for SRE talent, and act as the internal sponsor for the discipline.
  • Hire, grow and mentor a reliability engineering team based in China; build a durable talent pipeline in a competitive local market.

Hands-On Reliability Engineering

  • Personally lead major incident responses, root-cause analysis and remediation for SSv Technology platforms, coordinating across teams and regions to restore service rapidly and drive lasting fixes.
  • Drive self-healing-by-design: automated detection, safe auto-remediation patterns, resilience patterns and engineering guardrails that prevent repeat incidents and reduce manual intervention (toil).
  • Own stability, availability and end-to-end operational performance of business-critical SSv Technology platforms, with clear accountability for outcomes.
  • Drive adoption of observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana), automation and scripting (Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform), and modern distributed platforms (containers, microservices, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
  • Champion enterprise-authorised AI capabilities to accelerate SRE workflows — incident triage, investigation support and knowledge capture — with rigorous validation habits and data-sensitivity awareness.
  • Establish capacity and performance engineering practices (capacity planning, load testing, latency/throughput SLIs, saturation monitoring) for critical services.
  • Own and mature resilience validation (DR/BCP planning and regular failover testing; resilience game days where appropriate).

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to SSv business and technology stakeholders, providing concise, business-focused communication during incidents and strategic initiatives.
  • Partner closely with Production Services, Application Development, Infrastructure, Non-Functional Risk, and Compliance/Regulatory functions to improve platform stability and operational maturity.
  • Represent the SRE function in governance forums, service reviews, and China-specific regulatory or technology-risk discussions.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Formal training or certification in SRE concepts, extensive applied experience, including prior experience building or scaling a reliability engineering/SRE function from the ground up, ideally in a regulated financial-services environment.
  • Demonstrated Reliability Engineering mindset with evidence of designing self-healing systems and driving automation-first reliability improvements proactively (not only via process).
  • Proven experience leading new initiatives from scratch at scale (strategy, operating model, mobilisation, adoption and delivery across large engineering populations).
  • Demonstrated experience designing organisational models (central vs embedded vs hybrid) for reliability, platform, or infrastructure engineering functions.
  • Proven track record hiring, growing and retaining technical teams, ideally within the China/APAC technology talent market.
  • Strong systems thinking and problem-solving capability to assess complex, cross-domain, cross-regional production issues and drive end-to-end resolution.
  • Demonstrated major incident leadership, coordinating effectively across global teams to restore service rapidly and drive root-cause remediation.
  • Hands-on technology experience across cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), automation and scripting (Python, Shell, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform), and modern distributed platforms (containers, microservices, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
  • Strong observability and service management expertise (Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana; ITIL Incident/Problem/Change/Availability), with excellent verbal and written communication in English
  • Working knowledge of custody, fund services, and/or post-trade workflows, or strong transferable capital markets technology experience.
  • ITIL v4 certification (or equivalent service management experience) preferred.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Experience integrating support models and standardising operating practice across multiple regions or legal entities.
  • Background in organisational or cultural change leadership, particularly introducing a new engineering discipline into an established technology organisation.
  • Knowledge of Securities Services domains: custody, fund accounting, transfer agency, middle office, or post-trade processing would be an advantage.
  • Experience partnering with Front Office or client-facing teams to support business-critical, high-availability platforms.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of VP, FC Detection and DE.
Principal responsibilities
Set and own the AI product vision and AI-first roadmap for the FC Detection product portfolio, aligned to the future-state strategy, regulatory priorities and enterprise AI direction.
Lead AI-enabled product discovery with Financial Crime users, SMEs and delivery squads, redesigning detection journeys around AI rather than simply automating existing manual steps.
Shape AI-native and agentic product experiences (e.g., alert triage and disposition, adverse-media review and SAR narrative drafting), defining where agents act, where humans decide and how outcomes are evidenced.
Author product requirements for AI covering user outcomes, data needs, model and agent behaviour, evaluation criteria, guardrails and explainability requirements.
Apply thin-slice / MVP discipline: prioritise the backlog, define acceptance criteria and success metrics, and make evidence-based scale, iterate or stop decisions.
Own AI product testing and validation with engineering, data science and model risk partners, ensuring products are evaluated against baselines before they scale.
Shape investment cases and track value realisation (e.g., detection uplift, false-positive reduction, investigator productivity, time-to-decision and cost-to-serve).
Optimise data, model and cost trade-offs, and scale proven AI capabilities across products and markets through reusable patterns.
Coach product owners and product managers across the SVS to raise AI-native product maturity and consistency.
Partner with platform, architecture, cybersecurity and operations/support teams to ensure solutions are secure, compliant, observable and supportable in production.
Implement appropriate safety and data controls (e.g., data handling, privacy constraints, leakage prevention; and prompt-injection/grounding controls where GenAI is used).
Track and communicate delivery progress, risks and dependencies, escalating early to the SVS Lead with recommended mitigations.
Create reusable accelerators (templates, libraries, reference implementations) and share learnings to improve delivery speed and consistency across Financial Crime.
Requirements
Proven track record as a senior product manager or product owner delivering AI/ML or data-driven products from discovery through production and scale, ideally within financial services, risk or financial crime.

Embed AI-native capabilities into engineering workflows, such as AI coding, technical solution generation, test case generation, test report generation, and automated environment setup/orchestration.
Taking part in architecture design and core capability development for AI Agent Applications, including task orchestration, tool invocation, context management, memory mechanisms, and multi-agent collaboration.
Runtime governance & operational framework, Establish AI agent runtime and governance frameworks, including Isolation and sandboxing, access control and permission, Auditability and traceability Evaluation and quality measurement.
Knowledge augmentation layer design: integrate, and apply enterprise knowledge enhancement capabilities, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), GraphRAG, Knowledge graphs (design, integration, and application)
Partner across business lines and infrastructure team to align priorities, integrate requirements and unblock delivery across regions and time zones
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
8+ of experience delivering enterprise software/platform solutions including 3+ years in senior engineering leadership roles, especially 2+ years in Agentic AI development.
System thinking: Strong ability to design and evolve complex systems with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance.
Proficient in Python with strong coding fundamentals and architectural judgment; hands-on experience delivering complex systems. The candidate must have strong coding skills in Numpy, Panas, NLU, NLP and machine learning algorithms.
Deep understanding of LLMs and agent architectures, including:
Task decomposition & planning
Tool use / function calling patterns
Context and session management
Memory design
Execution loops and exception handling
Practical experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph (or equivalent orchestration frameworks).
Familiarity with mainstream AI coding and developer tools (examples: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or equivalence).
Hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise RAG, GraphRAG, or knowledge graph solutions for real application scenarios.
Proven track record designing, building, and operating large-scale, low-latency, highly available, resilient platforms and shared services (API gateway/service gateway experience strongly preferred)

Experience working in Agile delivery models with strong collaboration and execution discipline.

Experience with the following technologies (Hadoop, Spark, YARN, Kafka, Hive, HBase, MapReduce, RESTful services, Nosql database such as Mongo) would be an advantage.
Team player and experience working in global teams with members in different locations.
Aptitude to independently learn new technologies.

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our
customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.
扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系
根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证
卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力
Qualifications
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline
At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
至少5年以上客户经理经验
具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
普通话及英语流利
我们的福利
汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。
假期福利
除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。
全面的福利保险计划
包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。
员工体检
每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。
弹性福利
当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。
心理健康咨询
您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。
企业年金
汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。
弹性工作
为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。
PSQP专业进修计划
专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

Senior Consultant Specialist
.
Business:
IWPB Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Work as part of Global Digital Engineering team with responsibility for API delivery
Collaborate with API Architects & Technical Platform Architects to understand& feedback for the established API best practice
Work with Global Enterprise/Solution Architects to review end-to-end technical design.
Lead engineers to work on API delivery including API development & deployment with good quality & on schedule
Review/Ensure the technical design/code structure is technically coherent and future proof and compliance with technology standards and regulatory obligations
Identify any issues that may arise to delivery risk, formulate preventive actions or corrective measures and timely escalate major project risks & issues to senior management
Provide professional consultancy/support immediately for application teams’ queries/requests.
Requirements
University Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline
Solid and proficient skills in Java, Spring Framework, Web Service, JSON, RAML
Knowledge or experience in Enterprise Integration Platform (EIP) and API design with implementation experience on any ESB tools (e.g. IIB , Kong, MQ, SpringBoot)

：65894

Design and continuously evolve the frontend architecture and shared foundational capabilities of the AI Platform Portal, balancing consistency, extensibility, maintainability, and delivery efficiency.
Build high-quality product workflows for platform capabilities such as model services, RAG, Agents, and MCP, including backend API integration and asynchronous or streaming interactions where needed.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Senior Business Analyst
.
Business: Group DAO
Principal Responsibilities
The HK Reference Data Business Analyst role is required to deliver accurate, controlled migration of Customer Reference Data to support the delivery of CDMS HK. You’ll work with business and centralised migration execution teams to support migration activities end-to-end (analysis, mapping, cleansing, testing, reconciliation, cutover support), partnering closely with Technology, Operations, Data Owners, and Change teams to ensure data is complete, consistent, and fit for purpose. This is an individual contributor role (G5) with no people management responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To
Migration analysis & planning
Analyse source-to-target data movements for customer reference/master data domains (e.g., customer identifiers, names, addresses, contact details, tax residency indicators, KYC-related reference attributes).
Produce and maintain migration deliverables such as data scope, mapping specifications, transformation rules, data lineage notes, and reconciliation approach.
Support estimation and sequencing of migration waves; identify dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early.
Data quality, profiling & remediation
Perform data profiling to identify duplicates, missing values, invalid formats, and policy breaches.
Define and execute cleansing/remediation steps with Data Owners and upstream teams; track issues to closure.
Contribute to continuous improvement of data quality controls and repeatable migration playbooks.
Build support (requirements to engineering) & test execution
Translate business rules into clear requirements for ETL/configuration teams (or implement lightweight scripts where appropriate).
Create test scenarios and test data; execute SIT/UAT support activities focused on data outcomes.
Validate transformation logic through evidence-based checks (sampling + automated validations where possible).
Reconciliation, controls & cutover support
Run pre- and post-load reconciliations (record counts, key-field checks, exception reports, referential integrity checks).
Produce sign-off packs showing migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions with clear risk statements.
Support dress rehearsals and cutover weekend activities, including defect triage and rollback considerations.
Governance, risk & documentation
Ensure migration activities meet HSBC control expectations (audit trail, approvals, evidence retention, change controls).
Escalate risks/issues promptly with options and impact assessment.
Maintain high-quality documentation that can be understood by stakeholders across Hong Kong and global teams.
Stakeholder collaboration
Work effectively with Technology, Data Governance, Operations, Compliance/Financial Crime teams, and programme change resources.
Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions clearly—especially when trade-offs arise (time vs. quality vs. scope).
Key stakeholders
Technology (data engineering/ETL, application teams, testers)
Data Owners/Data Stewards
Operations/Customer Services teams (where data is originated/maintained)
Change/Programme Management
Risk & Compliance/Financial Crime (where data impacts controls and screening outcomes)
Requirements
Proven experience (typically 3–6 years) as a business and data analyst or similar in a complex, regulated environment (financial services preferred), working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
SQL (or equivalent) capability for data extraction, reconciliation and data analysis tasks.
Solid understanding of data quality management (profiling, controls, issue root-cause analysis) and working knowledge of data governance concepts (lineage, metadata, critical data elements).
Experience translating business requirements into analytical outputs (KPIs, metrics definitions, reporting packs), including documenting requirements and assumptions.
Exposure to reference/master data concepts and operating model practices (e.g., data standards, domain ownership, stewardship) is desirable.
Familiarity with Agile ways of working (user stories, sprint ceremonies) and collaborating effectively across business, operations and technology teams.
Strong communication skills: able to explain complex data findings clearly, challenge constructively, and influence outcomes with evidence.
Degree (or equivalent experience) in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics) or demonstrable applied analytical capability.
Experience working with operational teams to understand, map and improve end-to-end processes (e.g., SIPOC/process mapping), identifying data pain points, control gaps and opportunities for simplification/automation.
Proven involvement in data migration activities (e.g., legacy-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation rules, reconciliation and post-migration validation), supporting cutover readiness and hypercare where required.
Working knowledge of process change governance (impacts, risks, controls, training/adoption considerations) and how process changes affect upstream/downstream data flows and reporting.

jobs.title: Head of Business Continuity & Incident Management HSBC China
jobs.descriptionText:
GCOO - Asia & Middle East COO
Our GCOO organisation is critical for HSBC. This team partners closely with business teams to drive simplification and deliver exceptional customer outcomes in Asia and the Middle East region which covers 26 markets, 600+ offices and branches, and more than 140,000 employees. By strengthening our control environment and enhancing risk management, we drive operational excellence and enable the bank to deliver focused and sustainable growth in this super-region.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Control Ownership & Governance
Local Compliance: Ensure all local Business Continuity (BC) and Operational Resilience (OR) controls operate in strict accordance with local laws, regulations, and HSBC global standards.
Risk Oversight: Partner with regional teams to guide local Risk Owners (GB/GI), ensuring they clearly understand control appropriateness and effectiveness.
Monitoring & Reporting: Execute rigorous risk and control monitoring, manage identified issues with prioritised mitigation, and deliver high-quality control reporting to meet group and regulatory requirements.
Business Continuity Management (BCM)
Lifecycle Management: Own the planning and execution of a fit-for-purpose annual BC lifecycle, ensuring all analysis, planning, and exercise obligations are met.
Tool & System Excellence: Ensure high-quality usage of the Business Continuity Planning Tool and Emergency Notification System, setting mechanisms to review metrics and drive remediation where gaps exist.
Crisis Readiness: Oversee local contingency site provisions and support Real Estate Services as a BCIM advisor.
Major Incident Management (MIM)
Crisis Capability: Ensure mandated Major Incident Group (MIG) controls are active, including the facilitation of training and exercises for HBCN.
Threat Monitoring: Perform proactive threat monitoring and provide timely escalation to the MIG Chair, regional teams, and key stakeholders.
Incident Response: Lead the team in executing emergency notifications, managing local MIG invocations, and conducting post-incident reviews in line with Group standards.
Operational Resilience (OR)
Entity Level Coordination & Steering: Orchestrate activities at entity level to ensure timely delivery of key milestones, through active tracking, monitoring, review & challenge, reporting, and escalation.
Continuous Improvement: Drive simplification in processes, challenge the status quo, and leverage new tools to enhance resilience capabilities.
Stakeholder Management & Leadership
Trusted Advisor: Build and maintain strong relationships with local Heads of GB/GI, senior management, and regulators.
Ambassadorship: Act as the local face of BCIM/OR, advocating for resilience priorities and fostering an exchange culture across HSBC entities in China.
Team Leadership: Lead by example, building a motivated, engaged, and diverse local team. Champion integrity, accountability, and collaboration.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Proven Expertise: Significant experience in risk or control management, with a deep track record in managing Business Continuity and Operational Resilience lifecycles.
Crisis Leadership: Demonstrated experience in managing major incidents, training senior executives, and facilitating high-stakes crisis exercises.
Regulatory Knowledge: A deep understanding of global and local requirements related to BCIM and OR. Professional certification (e.g., CBCP, MBCI) is a significant advantage.
Strategic Agility: The ability to translate global and regional priorities into effective local actions, balancing competing demands to find the best solutions.
Decision Making: A confident decision-maker who can act decisively under pressure and within tight deadlines.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Global Mindset: Experience working within highly regulated, complex international organisations.
Language Skills: Fluency in English and the local language (Mandarin) is a prerequisite.
Values : High ethical standards, innovative thinking, and a commitment to "We Succeed Together."
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
普通话及英语流利

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionText:

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Senior Software Engineer
.
Business: Asia & Middle East Technology
Job ID: 66873
Principal Responsibilities
Participate in requirements discovery with the business, contributing to system analysis, effort estimation, and delivery planning.
Produce and maintain key delivery documentation in line with global and regional standards (e.g., High-Level/External Design, test strategy and plans, UAT plan, implementation/cutover plan).
Engage stakeholders directly and collaborate across teams, owning development and support activities with minimal supervision.
Deliver end-to-end ETL development, testing, and production release support to ensure stable and timely data delivery.
Act as a key quality gate for the project, driving engineering standards and controls to deliver on schedule and within budget.
Proactively improve data models and reusable modules to enhance availability, performance, and developer productivity.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree (or above) in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on experience delivering solutions on public cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), including core services such as compute, storage, networking, IAM, monitoring.
Strong programming skills in at least one of: Python / Java / Scala; solid SQL capability.
Proven experience with modern data processing (batch and streaming), and building reusable pipelines.
Experience working in Agile delivery teams; strong collaboration and stakeholder communication skills.
Strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills.
Strong team spirit, quality oriented and attentive to details.
Great sense of ownership and servicing mindset to ensure efficient and effective customer service processes.
Proficiency in both English and Mandarin.
/WX/ZP

jobs.title: Consultant Specialist
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist
.
Business:
CTO Data Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of the Hong Kong customer system transformation to CDMS.
Analyse existing customer system flows across online and batch processes to identify common capabilities, market-specific journeys, and opportunities for simplification.
Design, implement, and support technical solutions for customer data management in the Hong Kong market.
Ensure technology solutions align with business priorities, customer outcomes, and broader transformation goals.
Drive both Run-the-Bank and Change-the-Bank requirements in line with strategic objectives.
Provide technical leadership across development, testing, migration, and production implementation activities.
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions.
Data Management & Governance
Support the implementation of data governance standards, controls, and best practices.
Ensure high standards of data quality, integrity, security, and consistency across customer data platforms.
Translate business data requirements into effective technical solutions.
Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
Partner with business, operations, architecture, and engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Communicate complex technical and data concepts clearly to a wide range of stakeholders.
Work effectively across global and distributed teams, influencing decisions and driving alignment.
Delivery Excellence
Apply Agile delivery practices, including Scrum and SAFe, to manage priorities and execution.
Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity across coding, testing, and migration.
Manage multiple workstreams effectively while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.
Requirements
Strong hands-on experience leading software development and technical delivery in large-scale banking environments.
Deep understanding of customer systems in Hong Kong
Solid experience with legacy/mainframe technologies, including:
MVS/z/Series/CICS/JCL/DB2/PROC
Knowledge of modern integration technologies, including:
APIs/Spring Boot/NoSQL databases such as MongoDB
Experience with AI tools and automation for software engineering, testing, and migration activities.
Functional & Domain Knowledge
Strong understanding of customer data domains, customer lifecycle processes, and front-line customer-facing platforms.
Experience delivering large-scale, complex transformation programmes in banking or financial services.
Good understanding of the regulatory environment in financial services, particularly data-related controls and compliance considerations.
Knowledge of enterprise operating models, governance, and change delivery within large organisations.
Leadership & Soft Skills
Proven leadership experience in driving teams through large-scale technology and cultural change.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across business and technology functions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and time management skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.title: AVP - CRM (Full-stack)
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - CRM.
Principal responsibilities
Key expectations
Demonstrate strong ownership, accountability, and communication.
Deliver campaign automation software and tooling as an individual contributor.
Apply state-of-the-art AI technologies to solve real business problems.
Deliver to tight timelines with high quality and a continuous improvement mindset.
Take ownership of learning and development in partnership with your line manager.
Job accountabilities
Customer/ Stakeholder
Partner with multiple stakeholders to deliver automation toolkit and applications.
Build a strong understanding of the business domain, strategy, functional priorities, and required technical capabilities.
Drive innovation individually and within the team to deliver incremental business value.
Maintain an appropriate level of business and product knowledge.
Identify and shape AI-driven opportunities with stakeholders, translating business problems into well-defined AI use cases, success measures, and adoption plans.
Campaign and Project Delivery
Translate business needs into actionable tasks, functional and technical requirements, and detailed implementation plan.
Deliver high-quality outcomes through effective planning, stakeholder management, and quality controls.
Demonstrate strong productivity and reliable delivery.
Contribute to measurable team process improvement goals.
Design, develop, and integrate AI components into campaign automation solutions, including prototyping, evaluation, and iteration to meet business outcomes.
Process Efficiency and Controls
Produce cost-effective code and well-governed documentation; automate repetitive steps to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Implement QA/ QC controls to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.
Understand relevant policies and standards, and support leadership in applying them through practical governance for tooling development.
People, Values and Compliance
Role-model the Group Values: We Value Difference, We Succeed Together, We Take Responsibility, We Get It Done.
Maintain integrity and comply with HSBC standards on conduct, compliance, and Resilience Risk.
Complete all required functional and Group/Region-mandated training.
Support delivery of functional training where required.
Requirements
Work experience and education requirements
Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, CRM, or data analytics, with demonstrable delivery of production-grade applications (full software development lifecycle).
PhD or Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
Technical capability
Proven end-to-end engineering experience across:
Backend services and API development (RESTful design, authentication/authorisation, performance, observability).
Front-end UI development (responsive design, component-based frameworks).
Data modelling and persistence (SQL design, CRUD patterns, optimisation).
Productionisation (CI/CD, environments, monitoring, incident support).
Strong programming skills in one or more technology of each space of the following (preferred stack):
Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/ or Java (Spring Boot).
JavaScript/ TypeScript with React and/ or Vue; solid understanding of web fundamentals including HTML/ CSS and modern application architecture patterns is a plus.
SQL databases: PostgreSQL / MySQL/ BigQuery.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
