jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Engineer (Application Platform)
Business: CTO
Job ID：53372
Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
The Role
As a Principal Engineer, Application Platforms in CTO Platform Engineering & Architecture you’ll shape technical strategy and provide architecture oversight for next-generation application and AI platforms. The role focuses on accelerating time-to-market for a major platform while improving resilience and reducing operational overhead through integrated controls and open-source solutions. You’ll play a key role in progressing Kubernetes-as-a-Service (KaaS) by defining target architectures, setting technical direction and aligning plans across multiple teams. You’ll act as the senior technical authority for early product onboarding ensuring solutions are production-ready from day one across security resilience performance and operability. Success means consistent platform patterns across delivery teams faster safer releases and reduced rework and operational risk. You’ll also partner closely with developer platform teams to deliver coherent integration and a joined-up developer experience. The outcomes support application rewrite and decommissioning programmes reduced run-the-bank (RTB) cost and platform capability integration across estates.
What You'll Be Doing
Shape platform standardisation and simplification aligned to strategic objectives including application rewrite and decommissioning duplication reduction and RTB efficiency
Provide technical direction across the organisation aligned to platform strategy engineering standards and a consistent developer experience
Define and own reference architectures designs technical roadmaps and golden paths for onboarding workloads to KaaS
Embed an open-source-based engineering stack ensuring reference patterns and platform capabilities integrate cleanly and sustainably
Establish reusable engineering patterns components and reference implementations to improve delivery speed and consistency

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Lead Business Analyst
.
Business: Group DAO
Principal Responsibilities
The HK Reference Data Business Analyst role is required to deliver accurate, controlled migration of Customer Reference Data to support the delivery of CDMS HK. You’ll work with business and centralised migration execution teams to support migration activities end-to-end (analysis, mapping, cleansing, testing, reconciliation, cutover support), partnering closely with Technology, Operations, Data Owners, and Change teams to ensure data is complete, consistent, and fit for purpose. This is an individual contributor role (G5) with no people management responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To
Migration analysis & planning
Analyse source-to-target data movements for customer reference/master data domains (e.g., customer identifiers, names, addresses, contact details, tax residency indicators, KYC-related reference attributes).
Produce and maintain migration deliverables such as data scope, mapping specifications, transformation rules, data lineage notes, and reconciliation approach.
Support estimation and sequencing of migration waves; identify dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early.
Data quality, profiling & remediation
Perform data profiling to identify duplicates, missing values, invalid formats, and policy breaches.
Define and execute cleansing/remediation steps with Data Owners and upstream teams; track issues to closure.
Contribute to continuous improvement of data quality controls and repeatable migration playbooks.
Build support (requirements to engineering) & test execution
Translate business rules into clear requirements for ETL/configuration teams (or implement lightweight scripts where appropriate).
Create test scenarios and test data; execute SIT/UAT support activities focused on data outcomes.
Validate transformation logic through evidence-based checks (sampling + automated validations where possible).
Reconciliation, controls & cutover support
Run pre- and post-load reconciliations (record counts, key-field checks, exception reports, referential integrity checks).
Produce sign-off packs showing migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions with clear risk statements.
Support dress rehearsals and cutover weekend activities, including defect triage and rollback considerations.
Governance, risk & documentation
Ensure migration activities meet HSBC control expectations (audit trail, approvals, evidence retention, change controls).
Escalate risks/issues promptly with options and impact assessment.
Maintain high-quality documentation that can be understood by stakeholders across Hong Kong and global teams.
Stakeholder collaboration
Work effectively with Technology, Data Governance, Operations, Compliance/Financial Crime teams, and programme change resources.
Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions clearly—especially when trade-offs arise (time vs. quality vs. scope).
Key stakeholders
Technology (data engineering/ETL, application teams, testers)
Data Owners/Data Stewards
Operations/Customer Services teams (where data is originated/maintained)
Change/Programme Management
Risk & Compliance/Financial Crime (where data impacts controls and screening outcomes)
Requirements
Proven experience (typically 3–6 years) as a business and data analyst or similar in a complex, regulated environment (financial services preferred), working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
SQL (or equivalent) capability for data extraction, reconciliation and data analysis tasks.
Solid understanding of data quality management (profiling, controls, issue root-cause analysis) and working knowledge of data governance concepts (lineage, metadata, critical data elements).
Experience translating business requirements into analytical outputs (KPIs, metrics definitions, reporting packs), including documenting requirements and assumptions.
Exposure to reference/master data concepts and operating model practices (e.g., data standards, domain ownership, stewardship) is desirable.
Familiarity with Agile ways of working (user stories, sprint ceremonies) and collaborating effectively across business, operations and technology teams.
Strong communication skills: able to explain complex data findings clearly, challenge constructively, and influence outcomes with evidence.
Degree (or equivalent experience) in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics) or demonstrable applied analytical capability.
Experience working with operational teams to understand, map and improve end-to-end processes (e.g., SIPOC/process mapping), identifying data pain points, control gaps and opportunities for simplification/automation.
Proven involvement in data migration activities (e.g., legacy-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation rules, reconciliation and post-migration validation), supporting cutover readiness and hypercare where required.
Working knowledge of process change governance (impacts, risks, controls, training/adoption considerations) and how process changes affect upstream/downstream data flows and reporting.

ASSOCIATE, CHINESE CORPORATES, NORTH CHINA
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC
Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.
Assist Associate Director/ Director To
 Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
 Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
 Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
 Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
 Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
 Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
 By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
 By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.
Customers and Stakeholders: To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.
 By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
 By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
 By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
 To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.
Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.
 By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).
 By managing client meetings and ensuring that product partners actively participate in discussions concerning client requirements and needs.
 By working closely with customers to identify macro operating issues and to satisfy their requirements on a regional /local basis.
 Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved.
 Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
 Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance matters. Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)
Good team player
Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
Good verbal and written communication skills
Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
Good level of financial analysis ability
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of VP - CRM.
Principal responsibilities
The role is responsible for the management of all customer information and provision of analytical and data science deliverables for customer and banking initiatives and to support AMH activities. The individual is also expected to identify key trends that arise from the insights of customer data and work with other areas in AMH to ensure they are taken account of.
The suitable candidate should be a self-driven person and a leader by nature in taking full ownership of the deliverables. One should be technically profound and fully loaded with business acumen and communication skills. One will work hands-on with the Enterprise Data Warehouse and Jupyter environment for data and modeling process, and are required to deliver the results in a logical and ethical way to the stakeholders.
Design, formulate, and implement relevant solutions for the identified analytics project and convert analytical findings/solutions that will lead to achieving business goals (revenue growth, anti-attrition, and increasing customer engagement, etc.). During the process, closely collaborate with relevant teams/parties to obtain the supports required for these tasks. Elevate CRM capabilities to tailor make messaging strategies and journeys that best meet GC customer needs and deliver business outcomes.
Use company provided software tools to extract, collect, manipulate (e.g. subset and merge) raw data to prepare for further analysis. Then apply the appropriate analytics frameworks, statistic procedures or machine learning algorithms to analyze the data in order to provide actionable analysis findings. Interpret and present quantitative information as well as the findings in proper context so as to help in the investigations and decision making of the business.
To design and develop robust, relevant data mining solutions – descriptive or predictive, the incumbent should flexibly and innovatively apply diverse modelling methods including (but not limited to): decision tree, clustering, logistic regression, gradient boosting, neural network, random forest, support vector machine etc. Mobilise and optimize CRM resources to support the development and ongoing monitoring of GC contact strategies based on customers’ needs (right message at the right time through the right channel), ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and HSBC standards, with the ambition to lead the market.
Drive the improvement of cross border communications via feedback to the GC governance team to maximise customer contact for efficiency and effectiveness
Manage the timely delivery of output and effectively communicate with all stakeholders.
Requirements
Bachelor (minimum with 6+ year experience) or Master degree in relevant quantitative disciplines such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, Physics or a related discipline with a focus on use of analytics and optimization to influence business decisions.
Excellent hands-on analytical skills with proven ability to analyse complex data, identify key trends and opportunities, putting forward hypotheses and delivering recommendations.
Mature and independent professional to drive analytics workstream with minimal oversight
Train non-analyst stakeholders, teams and audiences to better use our digital analytics suite of tools.
Able to work independently with guidance from remote teams.
Excellent communication skills. Be able to understand the background of the audience and be able to communicate the message in an effective manner.
Proven knowledge and experience of SQL, Python and other Database/Data Manipulation tools (eg max-compute, BI).
Experience in data visualization tools and techniques – previous experience in Qliksense, Tableau or similar.
Good experience and knowledge of one of analytics tools – Python/R/SAS/SPSS/STATA.

jobs.title: Fraud Risk Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Global Risk and Compliance
Risk and Compliance is a global function that brings together all aspects of regulatory and financial crime risk management. Acting as risk stewards, and incorporating a range of specialist teams, we work together with the business and leverage advanced technology to help HSBC navigate a complex regulatory landscape and embed a sustainable approach to compliance risk management that supports safe growth and ensures fair outcomes for clients. Compliance aspires to continuously raise the bar and set leading standards across the industry to help HSBC safeguard its customers and the communities within which it operates.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
The role is set to fulfil regulatory requirements on Fraud Risk Steward responsibility, as well as Criminal Case Prevention.
The role holder is responsible for
supporting Head of Criminal Case Prevention and Fraud Management to implement the HBCN Fraud Risk Management and Criminal Case Prevention framework (at both headquarter and branch levels) to ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, internal codes and policies and good market practices.
supporting to guide GB/GIs to embed Global FC Fraud policy and risk management framework, including gap analysis, detection mechanism enhancement, process optimization, employee/non-employee vetting, etc.
supporting GB/GIs in setting external/internal fraud risk appetite and control mechanism.
providing internal fraud / external fraud policy guidance, definition and interpretation assistance; and preforming oversight activities, as well as consulting on dispensation requests
advising and challenging the 1LOD on all aspects of material internal and external Fraud Risk events.
Observing the latest regulatory requirements and fraud modes operandi, and designing the Fraud Risk/Criminal Case Prevention training material.
Promoting process simplification during external fraud control review and assessment.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Good understanding of regulatory environment, expectations and relevant regulations on Criminal Case Prevention.
Banking experience required with knowledge of banking systems, products and processes.
Sound knowledge of risk management and internal control framework.
Knowledge and awareness of current and ever changing Criminal Case trends and fraud trends.
Strong skills to handle multiple tasks in parallel.
Background of fraud risk management a plus.
Good understanding of lending facilities. Credit or business background a plus.
Good communication skills in English and Mandarin.
Good team work spirit and could work under pressure.

Acting as risk stewards, and incorporating a range of specialist teams, we work together with the business and leverage advanced technology to help HSBC navigate a complex regulatory landscape and embed a sustainable approach to compliance risk management that supports safe growth and ensures fair outcomes for clients. Compliance aspires to continuously raise the bar and set leading standards across the industry to help HSBC safeguard its customers and the communities within which it operates.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

The role is set to fulfil regulatory requirements on Fraud Risk Steward responsibility, as well as Criminal Case Prevention.

The role holder is responsible for

  • supporting Head of Criminal Case Prevention and Fraud Management to implement the HBCN Fraud Risk Management and Criminal Case Prevention framework (at both headquarter and branch levels) to ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, internal codes and policies and good market practices.
  • supporting to guide GB/GIs to embed Global FC Fraud policy and risk management framework, including gap analysis, detection mechanism enhancement, process optimization, employee/non-employee vetting, etc.
  • supporting GB/GIs in setting external/internal fraud risk appetite and control mechanism.
  • providing internal fraud / external fraud policy guidance, definition and interpretation assistance; and preforming oversight activities, as well as consulting on dispensation requests
  • advising and challenging the 1LOD on all aspects of material internal and external Fraud Risk events.
  • Observing the latest regulatory requirements and fraud modes operandi, and designing the Fraud Risk/Criminal Case Prevention training material.
  • Promoting process simplification during external fraud control review and assessment.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Good understanding of regulatory environment, expectations and relevant regulations on Criminal Case Prevention.
  • Banking experience required with knowledge of banking systems, products and processes.
  • Sound knowledge of risk management and internal control framework.

Principal responsibilities
Fraud Detection
The primary role is to rapidly disposition alerts via a preliminary review to filter alerts that can readily be negated (i.e. obviously show no signs of anomalous behavior) utilizing the internal system data sources to establish whether the anomalous behavior can be allayed and discount basic on the analyst and fraud sense.If not, the officer will conduct detailed investigation utilizing all internal and external sources available, and continue working on the same alert.
Once the Officer has reached a conclusion, if the case is deemed to not represent suspicious, it will be discounted. If it is deemed anomalous, the Officer will be conduct an outbound call for verification the suspicious activities. If confirmed as fraudulent, the Officer is required to follow up the action with customer, e.g. Education/Mitigation/Prevention etc.
In addition, the Senior Fraud Officer will handle inbound call, act as the Subject Matter expert of the department, and be the referral point for any queries posed by Associates, management, trainees and other stakeholders’ interventions. Also, the Senior Fraud Officer will work in the capacity of escalation filter depending on the business requirement of the department. Furthermore, the Senior Fraud Officer will be required to provide hands on support to new trainees’OJT , coaching for under performers, seeking procedural clarifications, ironing out grey areas, as well as communicating the updates to the team falls within the purview of the Senior Fraud Officer.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Retail Platform Principal Engineer
Business: WPS Technology
Responsibilities
Provide strategic technical leadership across engineering projects, ensuring alignment with business goals, architecture principles and regulatory/compliance requirements.
Architect and design scalable, resilient, secure microservices and event‑driven systems to support high‑throughput financial services workloads.
Lead adoption and governance of engineering standards, patterns and best practices (API design, domain‑driven design, CI/CD).
Hands‑on development and code review in core platforms; set standards for software craftsmanship across Morden Tech stacks and cloud‑native services.
Mentor and coach senior engineers and engineering leads; run regular technical deep dives, architecture reviews and cross‑team workshops.
Lead and facilitate blameless post‑mortems and structured root cause analysis (RCA), driving remediation plans and lessons learned into the development lifecycle.
Own the Tech Risk Control “book of work”: maintain backlog of control remediation tasks, coordinate with Risk/Compliance to define mitigations, track progress, and ensure audit readiness.
Drive the integration of AI/ML capabilities into production systems with appropriate controls for governance, model risk, explainability and data privacy.
Collaborate with product, security, ops and data teams to prioritise technical debt, reliability improvements and platform investments.
Represent engineering in stakeholder forums, technical governance boards and external partner engagements.
What you will be doing
Act as the technical owner for core platform domains, driving architecture, design and delivery across backend, data streaming and cloud infrastructure; focus deeply on 2–3 areas (e.g., Java/Spring, Kafka/Stream Processing, Cloud/Kubernetes).
Lead targeted technical deep‑dives (2–3 per quarter) to resolve architectural trade‑offs, eliminate chronic pain points and transfer knowledge across teams.
Own and deliver the Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items for your area: define remediations, coordinate cross‑functional delivery, produce evidence for audits and close out controls.
Run structured root‑cause analysis and blameless post‑mortems for major incidents, translate findings into prioritized fixes, and ensure follow‑through.
Provide hands‑on technical direction: participate in design reviews, code reviews, prototyping and proof‑of‑concepts to validate architecture decisions.
Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads; raise team capability through coaching, workshops and documented standards/patterns.
Collaborate with product, security, data and ops to align technical strategy with business objectives, regulatory requirements and non‑functional goals (scalability, resilience, security).
Drive adoption of cloud‑native and DevOps practices (CI/CD, observability) and ensure production readiness for new services and AI/ML components.
Qualifications
Certifications & Education
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline; MSc/PhD preferred.
Cloud certification(s) strongly preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
Desirable: Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), security or data governance certificates.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in financial services or regulated industries with demonstrable knowledge of regulatory controls, audit preparation and model risk governance.
Contributions to open source projects or academic/industry research; speaker at technical conferences is a plus.
Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engineering teams through technological transformations, and to operationalise AI safely at scale.
Deliverables & Success Measures
Architecture and platform designs that meet non‑functional requirements (scalability, resiliency, security).
Successful delivery of prioritized Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items and remediation actions.
Reduction in incident mean‑time‑to‑detect and mean‑time‑to‑recover through improved observability, RCA and runbooks.
Mature AI/ML deployment pipelines with documented governance, monitoring and model lifecycle controls.
High team engagement, evidence of knowledge transfer via deep dive sessions and measurable uplift in engineering capability.
Technical Skills & Experience
Familiar on one or more tech skill.
Strong Java expertise (Java 8/11/17/21/25), demonstrated through large‑scale, production systems.
Deep experience with Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data and related tooling.
Microservices and cloud‑native architectures: containerisation (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and 12‑factor app principles.
Event streaming and messaging: Apache Kafka (Kafka Streams, ksqlDB), Confluent tooling and best practices for exactly‑once semantics and fault‑tolerant processing.
Data platform familiarity: batch/stream processing (Spark, Flink), data lakehouse concepts (Delta Lake), and data governance tools (e.g. Apache Atlas, Apache Falcon or equivalent).
AI / ML / LLM productionisation: hands‑on with MLOps and Model frameworks (LangGraph, Agent Development Kit, Microsoft Agent Framework ); experience deploying and operating LLMs (e.g., Falcon family or other LLMs), embeddings, RAG architectures and frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Observability, reliability and performance engineering: Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, distributed tracing (Jaeger/Zipkin), profiling and tuning high‑throughput systems.
DevOps, CI/CD :Terraform, Ansible , G3 , and SonarQube.
Cloud platforms: proven experience on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production scale environments.
Security, compliance & risk controls: secure coding practices, threat modelling, encryption, key management and OWASP mitigation patterns.
You’ll achieve more at HSBC
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  • Mentor and coach senior engineers and engineering leads; run regular technical deep dives, architecture reviews and cross‑team workshops.
  • Lead and facilitate blameless post‑mortems and structured root cause analysis (RCA), driving remediation plans and lessons learned into the development lifecycle.
  • Own the Tech Risk Control “book of work”: maintain backlog of control remediation tasks, coordinate with Risk/Compliance to define mitigations, track progress, and ensure audit readiness.
  • Drive the integration of AI/ML capabilities into production systems with appropriate controls for governance, model risk, explainability and data privacy.
  • Collaborate with product, security, ops and data teams to prioritise technical debt, reliability improvements and platform investments.
  • Represent engineering in stakeholder forums, technical governance boards and external partner engagements.

What you will be doing

  • Act as the technical owner for core platform domains, driving architecture, design and delivery across backend, data streaming and cloud infrastructure; focus deeply on 2–3 areas (e.g., Java/Spring, Kafka/Stream Processing, Cloud/Kubernetes).
  • Lead targeted technical deep‑dives (2–3 per quarter) to resolve architectural trade‑offs, eliminate chronic pain points and transfer knowledge across teams.
  • Own and deliver the Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items for your area: define remediations, coordinate cross‑functional delivery, produce evidence for audits and close out controls.
  • Run structured root‑cause analysis and blameless post‑mortems for major incidents, translate findings into prioritized fixes, and ensure follow‑through.
  • Provide hands‑on technical direction: participate in design reviews, code reviews, prototyping and proof‑of‑concepts to validate architecture decisions.
  • Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads; raise team capability through coaching, workshops and documented standards/patterns.
  • Collaborate with product, security, data and ops to align technical strategy with business objectives, regulatory requirements and non‑functional goals (scalability, resilience, security).
  • Drive adoption of cloud‑native and DevOps practices (CI/CD, observability) and ensure production readiness for new services and AI/ML components.

Qualifications

Certifications & Education

  • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline; MSc/PhD preferred.
  • Cloud certification(s) strongly preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
  • Desirable: Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), security or data governance certificates.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services or regulated industries with demonstrable knowledge of regulatory controls, audit preparation and model risk governance.
  • Contributions to open source projects or academic/industry research; speaker at technical conferences is a plus.
  • Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engineering teams through technological transformations, and to operationalise AI safely at scale.

Deliverables & Success Measures

  • Architecture and platform designs that meet non‑functional requirements (scalability, resiliency, security).
  • Successful delivery of prioritized Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items and remediation actions.
  • Reduction in incident mean‑time‑to‑detect and mean‑time‑to‑recover through improved observability, RCA and runbooks.
  • Mature AI/ML deployment pipelines with documented governance, monitoring and model lifecycle controls.
  • High team engagement, evidence of knowledge transfer via deep dive sessions and measurable uplift in engineering capability.

Technical Skills & Experience

Familiar on one or more tech skill.

  • Strong Java expertise (Java 8/11/17/21/25), demonstrated through large‑scale, production systems.
  • Deep experience with Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data and related tooling.
  • Microservices and cloud‑native architectures: containerisation (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and 12‑factor app principles.
  • Event streaming and messaging: Apache Kafka (Kafka Streams, ksqlDB), Confluent tooling and best practices for exactly‑once semantics and fault‑tolerant processing.
  • Data platform familiarity: batch/stream processing (Spark, Flink), data lakehouse concepts (Delta Lake), and data governance tools (e.g. Apache Atlas, Apache Falcon or equivalent).
  • AI / ML / LLM productionisation: hands‑on with MLOps and Model frameworks (LangGraph, Agent Development Kit, Microsoft Agent Framework ); experience deploying and operating LLMs (e.g., Falcon family or other LLMs), embeddings, RAG architectures and frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).

  • DevOps, CI/CD :Terraform, Ansible , G3 , and SonarQube.
  • Cloud platforms: proven experience on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production scale environments.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Assistant Manager.
Principal responsibilities
The jobholder will be a member of the Business Analytics within Business Finance and Reporting team, providing management information and analytical support to the Global Head of Business Finance and Reporting. Key activities include the preparation of business management papers, reviewing and challenging external reporting results including forecast projections, and driving transformation initiatives around the financial planning processes, among others
Reporting Review: Support the review and challenge of the IFRS 17 results, including participation in governance forums to provide Group advice and challenges to financial analysis and management actions.
Forecasting Analytics: Support the analysis, interpretation, and development of solutions for Management Information to provide business insights and implications, including but not limited to budgeting and forecasting.
Result Communication and Consolidation: Fully understand the IFRS 17 reporting results from local entities and support the formulation of a Group ‘story’ around the numbers. Assist in the preparation of Group management information packs summarizing actuarial reporting results and project outcomes for various stakeholders.
Methodology and Basis Review: Support the review and challenge of the reasonableness of actuarial approaches, methodologies, assumptions, simplifications, and any actuarial judgments applied in IFRS 17 reporting to ensure compliance with the underlying IFRS 17 policies, controls, and risk framework, including participation in basis review committees.
Stay Informed: Keep abreast of developments and changes in accounting policies, methodologies, and processes to support an early assessment of IFRS 17 results impacts, strengthen SOX controls, and improve documentation around the production process.
Market Awareness: Stay informed about market practices, new topics discussed by industry discussion groups, and/or market surveys/statistics conducted by consultants and regulatory bodies.
Requirements
Experienced, qualified actuary with recognised professional body (e.g. IFoA, SOA).
Minimum 5 years of experience in financial reporting, with a proven track record within life insurance companies or consultancy firms,
Strong actuarial knowledge of IFRS17, familiar with the end-to-end reporting methodology, assumption, process, control and governance.
Strong writing and presentation skills, with expertise in presenting and producing high quality reports at governance forums.
Experience prophet modelling and/or understanding to finance system and accounting rule is an advantage.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.descriptionText:
汇丰保险经纪业务成立于2022年，作为我们在中国内地保险和财富产品分销的经纪渠道。作为汇丰集团的一部分，我们在中国内地致力于通过财富规划服务业务助力人们提高抵御风险能力、为他们自己及其亲人提供保障，实现他们的人生目标。
汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。
汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，
通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：
厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；
工作职责
主要工作包括：
拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。
任职要求
本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
5-8年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者
善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑

Principal responsibilities
The AVP - Cost Management Analyst Role Will
Develop new datasets which link supplier spend to operational costs and revenues to support customer-centric business decisioning regarding cost reduction initiatives
Support development of Total Cost of Ownership models which allow management to make fact-based business decisions with full visibility of the impact on customers and revenue.
Involve frequent liaison with a large range of stakeholders including:
Key leadership roles across Cost Management
Category managers and Buyers in Procurement
Other Analytics teams in Procurement and Global Operations
Work collaboratively as a team of data experts to ensure that the teams objectives are met
Provide the leadership team with data that gives confidence in the delivery of quality and service in line with Cost Management commitments and obligations
Identifies opportunities to continuously improve and optimize the capabilities of the Cost Management program by extensively reviewing and improving existing processes
Review of analysis, MI and reporting. Drawing out key themes, trends or risks that could both positively or negatively affect the achievement of HSBC's organizational objectives
Leads and manages initiatives to embed and maintain a culture where good data management and quality practices prevail
Ensure data practices comply with regulations of all locations
Ensure good practices in the management of data tools, standards, frameworks and templates
Track adherence to policies, frameworks and tooling associated to Data Governance and Data Quality
Govern relationships between data elements across different systems

7+ years of hands-on analytics experience solving complex business problems using data and the communication of such to business and senior stakeholders is desirable
Prior experience in identifying and creating a framework for continuous technical learning
Prior Cost Management experience related with a financial institution or at a regulatory agency or major consulting firm is desirable
A good understanding and experience of the Global Businesses and Global Functions within a Bank.
Prior experience of working across 1 or more Risk Domains is desirable (providing support and guidance to business functions);
Ability to accurately determine customer needs & offer appropriate support

jobs.title: 资深财富及财务规划总监 Experienced Wealth and Financial Specialist (5F)
Senior Sales Manager-Institution Group
jobs.descriptionText:
Global Payments Solutions (GPS)
HSBC is recognised as one of the top tier providers of Global Payments Solutions in the Asia-Pacific region. As more corporate and institutional clients continue to consolidate their banking activities with the introduction of payments and cash management services, the potential growth of this business is substantial. Our customers view our regional client service proposition as a key element in deciding with whom to mandate their business.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Achieve income for the Group by originating leads, building and maintaining relationships with new and existing clients, identify business opportunities and sell innovative payments and collections, liquidity and cash management solutions to Financial Institutions and Public Sector particularly Chinese banks including Big4 , nationwide joint-stock commercial banks, city commercial banks and Multinational Development and Central banks, Sovereign Wealth Funds etc. of HSBC's Global Banking.
Be able to lead and develop GPS business strategy for Banks and PS sector clients in China by navigating, mobilizing the bank’s resources, network and global platform, and collaborating with stakeholders across functions globally, regionally and locally to achieve the outcome.
Excellent command of understanding sector clients’ business model, identifying clients business needs and providing market-leading and customized payments and cash management solutions to sector clients. Share Payment and Cash management best practices, industry trends and payment solutions with clients.
Responsibility for providing solutions, pricing, negotiating and reviewing the full range of payments, liquidity and cash management solutions for sectors clients, together with effecting any cost reduction initiatives required by the HSBC Group. The jobholder is ultimately responsible for new sales revenue generation from new and existing clients as well as income aligned to a portfolio within the Sectors.
Initiate, develop and execute sales and marketing plans to increase GPS business and market share penetration.
As Global Sales, be able to engage and liaise with internal and external stakeholders globally including FIG and PS Coverage, Product, Customer Service, FCC and Regulatory Compliance etc. to achieve business outcome.
Maintain close liaison with key overseas product stakeholders particularly in the US, EU and HK so as to collaborate and provide input to the strategic direction of the business, the functionality and launch of new products and services to keep abreast of the industry.
Keep Management informed of progress and major obstacles towards progress on Sales targets.
A proven ability working across cultures in a complex environment and will maintain effective business knowledge to develop trust and confidence within the business and with clients.

jobs.title: Business Development Coach
jobs.descriptionText:
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Supporting tasks to assist in maintaining and strengthening distribution channel relationships, whilst coordinating the relevant business initiatives.
Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, enhance insurance sales capabilities, and achieve sustained performance growth.
Train core competencies across the full sales process, implementing insurance sales competency development, including execution of phone appointments, in-depth KYC, case solution and closing.
Train and coach RM to how complete Policy Review and analyse Policy Review Reports to customers
Participate in customer events and training sessions, assist with pre-event preparations, provide on-site support, and conduct post-event evaluations and follow-ups.
Support relationship managers in analyzing and diagnosing client needs, designing tailored solutions, and preparing for client meetings. Enhance practical capabilities through role-play and rehearsals focused on solution presentation and deal closing.
Provide coaching on sales strategies for INSH proprietary products, building on the foundational training delivered by Business Development Managers. Help relationship managers improve practical product skills, including aligning product features with client needs and integrating relevant service resources.
Analyze market trends and competitor products to identify and articulate the core strengths of INSH products. Develop sales strategies aligned with client profiles, incorporating sales logic and applicable scenarios. Continuously refine strategies through case reviews to improve sales effectiveness
Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, assisting RM to complete pre-case/pre-meeting.
Supporting the development and execution of channel development plans and strategies, continuously optimizing existing cooperation models.
Collaborating with stakeholders, which may include relationship managers and product team, to maximise empowerment for distribution channels.
Assisting in execution of compliance review processes and due diligence to ensure all operations adhere to risk control requirement.
协助建立并维护与分支行及相关业务部门的良好合作关系，确保合作顺畅及内部服务体验。
负责提供一对一教练式的陪跑辅导，实现知识向技能转化，提升保险销售能力，以实现绩效持续稳定的增长。
训练全销售流程的核心技能，实施保险销售能力养成，包含电话约访、深度KYC、解决方案呈现及成交等。
培训并指导客户经理如何完成保单检视，并指导如何为客户分析保单检视报告。
参与行所沙龙及内部培训等活动，配合做好活动前相关准备工作，提供现场赋能支持，并做好活动后的评估及。活动效果的跟进。
协助客户经理完成客户需求分析与诊断，设计解决方案；并做好相应面谈准备，通过演练、预演递交解决方案及成交过程，提升客户经理的实战作业能力。
负责产品强化训练辅导，针对INSH自有产品在由业务发展经理完成的销售资质培训基础上开展产品销售策略的训练辅导，帮助客户经理提升产品相关的实战能力，包含产品功能与客户需求的匹配分析，以及与产品功能相关的服务资源整合。
负责市场及同业产品对比分析，通过分析提炼INSH产品核心优势，结合销售逻辑及应用场景，整理与客户概貌相匹配的产品销售策略，并通过典型案例复盘持续优化策略，提升销售有效性。
支持制定并执行新业务拓展计划与策略，持续优化现有合作模式。
与产品部门、客户经理及相关团队保持紧密协作，最大化赋能合作渠道。
严格协助执行相关客户尽职调查及合规审查工作，做好风险控制。
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Reasonable experience in sales force (5 years )
Possess board-based knowledge of the Insurance business and China practices
Good influential skills – able to influence people of different cultures and backgrounds
Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Chinese. Must be able to communicate effectively in Putonghua.
Excellent interpersonal skills – excellent customer relationship management
Able to lead, inspire, motivate and develop the teams to deliver business performance and a team player.
具备5年以上销售或业务相关工作经验，有银行渠道或金融机构合作经验者优先
熟悉保险业务及金融产品，了解国内银行渠道业务模式及监管要求
具备良好的沟通协调能力及影响力，能够与不同层级的银行人员建立有效合作
中英文口头与书面沟通能力优秀，必须能流利使用普通话进行商务沟通
具备较强的客户服务意识及关系维护能力，能妥善处理渠道合作中的各项事务
具备团队协作精神，能配合内部团队共同推动业务发展，达成整体目标

.

Group Functions Technology L3

Part of a pod of Data Engineers that supports multiple GCP development projects.

Experience writing Jenkins pipelines, developing jobs that can be re-used across delivery teams

Scala
Spark

Fluent English writing and speaking skills

Excellent communication skills

Java
Python
AI

Financial crime detection or other related bank business knowledge

jobs.title: 财富及财务规划专家 Wealth and Financial Specialist (7C)
财富及财务规划专家 Wealth and Financial Specialist (7C)
jobs.descriptionText:
汇丰保险经纪业务成立于2022年，作为我们在中国内地保险和财富产品分销的经纪渠道。作为汇丰集团的一部分，我们在中国内地致力于通过财富规划服务业务助力人们提高抵御风险能力、为他们自己及其亲人提供保障，实现他们的人生目标。
汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。
汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，
通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：
厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；
工作职责
主要工作包括：
拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。
任职要求
本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
3年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者或其他行业5年以上销售或销售管理经验
善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。
汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，
通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：
厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；
工作职责
主要工作包括：
拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。
任职要求
本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
3年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者或其他行业5年以上销售或销售管理经验
善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Company relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Insurance Brokerage Company Limited

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory
Qualifications - External
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
Strong presentation and sales skills
Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
Good interpersonal and communication skills
Customer service orientation
Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
www.hsbc.com.cn/careers
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC
Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Co-ordinate origination and execution of in-country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
Strong PC skills (excel, powerpoint etc)
Good team player
Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
Good verbal and written communication skills
Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
Good level of financial analysis ability
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

jobs.descriptionText:
CIB - Markets Operations
This team is the backbone of our Global Markets business (one of the largest of its kind in the world) and combines sophisticated 24-hour global coverage with a detailed knowledge of local markets and specialises in foreign exchange, credits and rates, structured derivatives, equities and debt, equity and equity-linked capital markets.
Markets Operations is responsible for driving every part of the trade lifecycle post-execution. This team manages settlement activity, risk and control, adherence to regulatory compliance, and seamless operational client service across 58 countries and territories.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Ensure the successful processing of daily margin payments, & that all FIM, Audit and regulatory controls and requirements are met at all times.
Ensure that we know and understand the business, organisation structure and contacts of all our clearing clients & internal clients.
Ensure that we act as an effective point of contact for our clearing and collateral clients on any transaction, account, margin static or market / product related query.
Ensure that client queries are handled in a professional manner by acknowledging, owning to resolution and demonstrating turnaround in line with what has been agreed.
Act as a second level check when not conducting margin call processing or inputting.
Daily review of bank reconciliation items and clearance of these items within agreed timeframes
Implement a strong client profiling process.
Active participation in the design, testing and rollout of new processes and strategic systems.
Provide support & share knowledge on markets, products, procedures and core operating platforms for team-members.
Ensure that you subscribe to formal objectives & personal development program with your manager.
Ensure that you actively seek regular 1:1 meetings and commit to written minutes and follow-up actions.
Participate actively to teamwork & leadership training & initiatives provided by the Bank.
Participate readily in operations and business related projects.
Safeguards the Company from potential loss and ensures that all procedures are strictly adhered to.
Constantly reviewing procedures and workflows, identifying necessary changes or enhancement and escalating to the line managers.
Ensure that daily controls & checklists are completed accurately and on a timely manner, providing appropriate policing and enforcement within the team.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
The Candidate Must Demonstrate a Strong Understanding Of
Global Markets products
Margin and Collateral
Clients and operational processing risk
HSBC FIM and risk requirements around generic practices

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Fraud Investigator Specialist.
Principal responsibilities
Handle inbound/outbound customer calls in English and Mandarin for fraud verification, lost card cases, and fraud reporting.
Monitor and action fraud alerts across cards and payments, verifying suspicious activity with customers.
Take immediate prevention actions (e.g., stop/decline transactions, block/replace cards, apply account safeguards).
Document case outcomes accurately and escalate higher-risk or complex cases for investigation.
Work closely with China and India teams to deliver consistent coverage and service standards.
Requirements
Fluency in Mandarin and English with confident, customer-friendly phone communication skills.
Strong judgement and ability to make timely, risk-based decisions while following defined procedures and controls.
High attention to detail with accurate case documentation and system updating.
Ability to manage high call volumes, prioritise workloads, and work effectively in a fast-paced, shift-based environment.
A collaborative mindset and comfort working across locations (China and India) and with multiple stakeholders.
Experience in fraud operations, financial crime operations, cards/payments operations, or a customer contact centre risk role will be a plus.
Willingness to work 24/7 rotating shifts, including weekends and public holidays, as required.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Fraud Investigator Specialist.
Principal responsibilities
Handle inbound/outbound customer calls in English and Mandarin for fraud verification, lost card cases, and fraud reporting.
Monitor and action fraud alerts across cards and payments, verifying suspicious activity with customers.
Take immediate prevention actions (e.g., stop/decline transactions, block/replace cards, apply account safeguards).
Document case outcomes accurately and escalate higher-risk or complex cases for investigation.
Work closely with China and India teams to deliver consistent coverage and service standards.
Requirements
Fluency in Mandarin and English with confident, customer-friendly phone communication skills.
Strong judgement and ability to make timely, risk-based decisions while following defined procedures and controls.
High attention to detail with accurate case documentation and system updating.
Ability to manage high call volumes, prioritise workloads, and work effectively in a fast-paced, shift-based environment.
A collaborative mindset and comfort working across locations (China and India) and with multiple stakeholders.
Experience in fraud operations, financial crime operations, cards/payments operations, or a customer contact centre risk role will be a plus.
Willingness to work 24/7 rotating shifts, including weekends and public holidays, as required.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

jobs.title: AVP, Investigative Tooling
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP, Investigative Tooling.
Principal responsibilities
Impact on the Business
Support agreed use cases from discovery through controlled production release by completing assigned analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and deployment activities. Translate defined user needs into practical technical outputs and provide evidence against agreed measures for investigation quality, decision consistency, detection effectiveness, investigator capacity, risk reduction, safety, control, reliability and supportability.
Contribute to reusable templates, libraries, evaluation harnesses and reference implementations, following established standards and documenting work so it can be maintained and reused by other squads.
Customer / Stakeholders
Work with Product Owners, investigators, Financial Crime subject-matter experts, Technology teams and control functions to understand defined use cases, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes. Gather field evidence, support workflow testing, prepare user guidance and training materials, and raise observed workarounds, automation bias, control degradation or adoption issues to the Senior Forward Deployment Engineer and relevant owner.
Leadership and Teamwork
Deliver assigned forward-deployment work under the technical direction of the Senior Forward Deployment Engineer. Apply agreed engineering, evaluation and safety standards; clarify ambiguous requirements; document assumptions and decisions; raise risks, blockers and failed assumptions early; and share learning and reusable work with engineers and analysts across Investigative Tooling.
Demonstrate inclusive collaboration across geographies, roles and backgrounds, welcoming different perspectives to reach better outcomes faster.
Communicate progress, technical options, trade-offs, dependencies and risks clearly, seeking guidance and escalating early where decisions or additional support are required.
Operational Effectiveness and Control
Build, test and support capabilities using agreed engineering practices, proportionate controls and defined evaluation methods. Produce the technical evidence required for release and confirm that ownership, support, monitoring, incident response, change, rollback and decommissioning arrangements have been documented by the accountable owners. Support production monitoring and promptly escalate breaches of agreed quality, safety, performance, cost or control thresholds.
Management of Risk
For each assigned deployment, identify and document relevant operational, conduct, data, model, cybersecurity and financial crime risks using approved methods. Provide evidence for required reviews and approvals, implement agreed human-review, monitoring, rollback and suspension controls, and escalate gaps or concerns to the Senior Forward Deployment Engineer and accountable control owner. Follow approved architecture, engineering and governance standards and support remediation of audit or regulatory findings.
Requirements
Hands-on engineering experience in Python and exposure to PyTorch or an equivalent machine-learning framework, gained through employment, internships, academic work or substantial personal projects. Working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, API integration, evaluation, cloud technologies, automated testing, deployment practices and observability, with the ability to apply secure engineering principles under guidance.
Experience contributing to the development or delivery of software or AI capabilities through several stages of the lifecycle, such as user discovery, prototyping, testing, release or operational support. Familiarity with enterprise integration, data pipelines, production monitoring, incident management, resilience and controlled change is desirable; direct ownership of each stage is not required.
An interest in financial crime investigations and the ability to learn relevant workflows, evidence standards and case-management practices. Able to work with business stakeholders to understand use cases and acceptance criteria, explain technical work clearly, collaborate in a multidisciplinary team, respond constructively to challenge, and escalate competing delivery, operational or control priorities.
Desirable: Exposure to agentic AI systems, model or platform evaluation, latency and cost optimisation, reusable engineering components, embedded product-delivery models, or integration with Spring Boot or React applications. Deep implementation expertise in these areas is not required.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Global Trade Solutions Client Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
CIB - Global Trade Solutions (GTS)
Trade has been the foundation of HSBC since 1865, it is evolving fast and so are we. With our network, expertise, and solutions we’re placed to help clients make sense of emerging trends, risks, and opportunities by being the global connectors, innovative problem solvers and strategic partners.
We connect the world through trade. Our footprint gives clients access to roughly 90% of world trade flows providing a powerful mix of local, regional, and global knowledge to help them spot new growth opportunities. We are innovative problem solvers that provide a safer, smoother digital trade experience. We solve business challenges through growth, disruption, or uncertainty, and we bring clients insights and ideas to enable grow and protect their business.
Our comprehensive suite of products and services can be combined into global solutions that help make it easier for businesses to manage trade risk, process trade transactions, and fund trade activities.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Grow business volume through delivering an exceptional customer experience and proactively engaging customers for business.
Retain business through addressing customer issues and feedback/complaints related to GTS transactions.
Refer new business opportunities to Sales and RM teams.
Provide customer feedback to applicable GTS teams when propositions impact the customer experience.
Provide an industry-leading customer experience for high-value GTS customers, with a view to increasing and retaining business.
Provide value-added service to customers, including advice on GTS products, processes, and transaction documentation, Service Reviews, Trade Academies, and other events.
Liaise with GTS Services, Sales, Relationship Managers, WCOO and other stakeholders to ensure customer issues are addressed and urgent transactions are processed in a timely manner.
Maintain visibility of customer feedback, errors, and complaints received, addressing and remediating them where addressable and providing feedback to other teams where applicable.
Provide customers with technical advisory and clarification on transactional issues.
Actively follow urgent transactions from key customers to completion.
Prioritise activities efficiently, according to the value provided to customers and the bank.
Ensure adherence to all applicable laws, regulations, Group policies, procedures and standards.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University degree and/or experience relevant to customer service, sales, or operations
Solid knowledge of Core Trade, Guarantees, Supply Chain and/or Receivables Finance
Excellent interpersonal skills, including verbal and written communication skills (in
English and local language) and the ability to negotiate and influence others
Ability to use strong judgement to identify and resolve problems whilst maintaining
service performance
Demonstrated ability to multitask and work independently, as well as work
collaboratively
Ability to manage crises; making good and timely decisions in tough situations
Desirable: knowledge of HSBC’s organization structure, business products/ solutions
particularly GTS and eChannel’s, operations and systems/processes

jobs.title: Senior Customer Relations Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Customer Relations Manager.
Principal responsibilities
Handle escalated complaints from various channels via an end-to-end process from complaint classification, review, investigation, resolution recommended to communications with customers concerned.
Resolve customer complaints and build customer loyalty to ensure relationship retention and uphold the Bank integrity and good reputation
Maintain service excellence and effectiveness in interacting with customers in a professional manner including verbal and written communications
Ensure the complaint handling meeting the internal quality and control standards plus regulatory requirements
Leverage AI Technology to optimize the complaint handling process and support the execution of a range of complaint-related tasks.
Collect and report on customer pain points and recommend customer journey enhancements to uplift customer experience and preempt customer complaints
Share best practices of complaint handling with other customers facing colleagues
Undertake speedy actions to minimize impacts of incidents affecting respective daily operations and business activities
Proactively instill HSBC core values and business principles
Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, business or related discipline;
University degree in related discipline or relevant experience
Work experience in financial institutions including good exposure to complaint handling tasks and customer-facing experience
Familiar with retail and wealth management products and services plus and related operations preferred
Customer centric mindset, strong business sense plus positive and sincere work attitude
High degree of personal drive and resilience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including fluent in English, Cantonese, and Putonghua
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

jobs.descriptionText:
International Wealth and Premier Banking
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
The role's main responsibilities include acting as primary point of contact for high net worth or ultra high net worth individual clients externally and clients internally for flow transactional banking elements with the client base. This role supports one or more Relationship Managers to deepen high net worth or ultra high net worth individual client relationships and improve income generation through focused business development activities.
This job will carry out some or all of the following tasks:
Maintain the highest standard of excellence in client service by attending to client enquiries and requests
Ensure client account opening documents are complete and accurate and requirements are met and ensure that any data input is dealt with in a timely manner and in the correct and consistent format
Assist Relationship Managers in taking orders and preparing daily transactions accurately, promptly and completely and ensures smooth coordination with processing departments
Ensure that all client-service related activities are fully in compliance with the processes and procedures
Prompt and appropriate action taken to address client feedback/complaints.
Build and maintain positive and productive working relationships internally and externally
Ensure smooth coordination with processing departments
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, related field or equivalent experience
Proven and progressive private banking experience or equivalent
Proven customer service, communications, sales, mathematical, analytical, organizational, and planning skills
Good understanding of the major products/services available in the private banking industry
IT Skills – knowledge of Microsoft Office Applications
Excellent communication skills
A good team player with drive for success and achievement
